run_visualize_scenario: run the visualize_scenario test script to record and visualize a CraftAssist agent scenario with pyglet
create_world_with_players_and_mobs: create a World instance with players, mobs like cows and chickens, and an agent using Opt and spec
record_fake_agent_steps: record FakeAgent steps over 100 iterations and save the Recorder to a pickle file
visualize_recorded_scenario: visualize a recorded agent scenario by loading a pickle file into a Window and running pyglet
set_logical_form_command: set a logical form command like BUILD or MOVE on a FakeAgent with a speaker name
